mapper.select: select b.attachment_name as attachmentName, b.attachment_num as attachmentNum, a.device_serial_number as deviceSerialNumber, b.sample_pool_num as samplePoolNum from t800_uv_inexus.t_ins_info_temp a inner join t800_uv_inexus.t_measure_pool b on a.attachment_type = b.attachment_num where a.device_serial_number = #{device_serial_number}
